blocks.text: It is the first step of gene expression. During transcription, a complementary RNA is synthesised from DNA. Only one strand of DNA, called the template strand, is transcribed. The mRNA synthesised in transcription is complementary to the template strand of DNA. The other strand of DNA that is not transcribed is called the coding strand because it has the same sequence as the transcribed mRNA, except T takes the place of U. The following are the main phases of the transcription of mRNA.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: The template strand of DNA is also known as the antisense (–) strand and coding strand as the sense (+) strand.
